spans.s: धृष् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (pp. धर्षित; pres. धर्षति) 1. To come together, to be compact; 2. to hurt, to injure.
धृष् (II) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. धर्षति, धर्षयति-ते) 1. To offend, to injure; 2. to insult, to treat with indignity; 3. to assail, to overpower, to conquer.
धृष् (III) vi. or vt. 5P (pp. धृष्ट; pres. धृष्णोति) 1. To be bold or courageous; 2. to be confident; 3. to be impudent or impatient; 4. to brave.
धृष् (IV) vt. 10Ā (pres. धर्षयते) To assail, to attack.
धृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Bold, courageous, confident; 2. impudent, rude, shameless; 3. forward, presumptuous; 4. profligate, abandoned.
धृष्ट (II) m. A faithless husband or lover not ashamed of his fault; (the S.D. thus describes him- कृतागा अपि निःशंकस्तर्जितोऽपि न लज्जितः । दृष्टदोषोऽपि मिथ्यावाक् कथितो धृष्टनायकः).
धृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Bold, courageous, confident; 2. impudent, rude, shameless; 3. forward, presumptuous; 4. profligate, abandoned.
धृष्ट-मानिन् a. having a high opinion of oneself.
धृष्णि m. A ray of light.
धृष्णु a. 1. Courageous, bold; 2. impudent, shameless.
